The Howard Case is a 1936 British crime film directed by Fraser Foulsham and Frank Richardson and starring Jack Livesey, Olive Sloane and David Keir. It was produced as a quota quickie for release by Universal Pictures.
Synopsis
A lawyer plots to murder his cousin and then frame his business partner.
Cast
* Jack Livesey as Jerry
* Olive Melville as 	Pat
* Arthur Seaton as 	Howard / Phillips
* Olive Sloane as 	Lena Maxwell
* David Keir as 	Barnes
* Jack Vyvyan as Sergeant Halliday
* Ernest Borrand
* Vincent Sternroyd
* Gladys Mason
* Renaud Lockwood
